    region_idx = vor.point_region[i]

import pandas as pd
from sqlalchemy import text

# Use PostGIS to compute Voronoi polygons
# First, create a temporary table with station points
query = text("""
WITH station_points AS (
    SELECT id, name_en, 
           ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(ST_X(coordinate::geometry), ST_Y(coordinate::geometry)), 4326) as geom
    FROM air_quality_station
),
voronoi AS (
    SELECT id, name_en, (ST_Dump(ST_VoronoiPolygons(ST_Collect(geom)))).geom as cell_geom
    FROM station_points
),
bbox AS (
    SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakeEnvelope(
        (SELECT MIN(ST_X(coordinate::geometry)) FROM air_quality_station),
        (SELECT MIN(ST_Y(coordinate::geometry)) FROM air_quality_station),
        (SELECT MAX(ST_X(coordinate::geometry)) FROM air_quality_station),
        (SELECT MAX(ST_Y(coordinate::geometry)) FROM air_quality_station)
    ), 4326) as bbox_geom
)
SELECT v.id, v.name_en, 
       ST_Area(ST_Intersection(v.cell_geom, b.bbox_geom)) as area_deg2
FROM voronoi v, bbox b
